newsitem.title: USA: BPA cuts Thurs shoulder hour prices by $10/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA cuts Thurs shoulder hour prices by $10/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) lowered its prices for firm power during shoulder hours on Thursday (0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2200 PST) by $10.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Wednesday.
BPA continued to offer up to 300 megawatts of power during those hours, but no power was offered during hours ending 0800-1000 and 1800-2000 PST.
Thursday firm power during shoulder hours was offered at $30.00 per MWh to Northwest buyers and at $31.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
Thursday offers for firm power during off-peak hours (0100-0600 and 2300-2400) were unchanged at $12.50 per MWh.
Prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 was also unchanged at $12.50 per MWh for Wednesday, while hours ending 0600, 2300 were priced at $20.75.
BPA also continued to offer displacement power for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PST at $9.00 per MWh.
